_readme: V6 match % weights. Match % = Fit*fit + Odds*odds + Preferences*prefs (weights sum to 1). Sub-weights are relative. Unknown inputs are left out and lower confidence. Edit here only.

eliteFirm._readme: Firms with tier 1 in config.json firmTiers (each has a cited public acceptance-rate source). Weak profiles are capped.

grader._readme: V9: thin profile (fewer than minProfileParts of major/interests/skills/experience) or thin listing (fewer than minKnown scored inputs) is shown as 'Not enough info to grade'.
